365SCORES

Career
opportunities

365scores employees are part of a professional and happy community, which has social and gender diversity. Being part of our team means sharing a place where the work environment is flexible and pleasant, and the atmosphere is open and invites everyone to be heard, contribute. The employees we are looking for should be professionals and visionaries who live and breathe the worlds of mobile and sports.

At 365scores, we’ve been rocking the sports world since 2012 as the ultimate scores app, with a whopping 110 million fans globally. We eat, sleep, and breathe sports, and our mission is to keep the fans engaged with real-time updates, scores, and in-depth data about their favorite teams and players across an action-packed lineup of leagues and competitions from around the world. So, if you’re passionate about sports and tech, roll up your sleeves – you might find a front-row ticket for your dream job on this site!
